access_wrong: Access protection is missing or wrong. Check the Cloud Connect settings.
account_manager_note: Switching accounts locks the current account. Each account has one 24-word recovery phrase, its own settings and its own Cloud Connect data.
account_terms_body:
Traeky is a community tool for locally recording and evaluating crypto and portfolio data.

Traeky does not provide financial, investment, tax or legal advice. Calculations, prices, reports, tax summaries, import results and Cloud Connect or sync status can be incomplete, outdated or incorrect.

You are responsible for checking all data, prices, classifications, tax assumptions and reports yourself. Operators, maintainers and contributors accept no liability for incorrect data, lost data, financial decisions or resulting damages.
account_terms_accept: I have read and accept the Terms / Disclaimer.
account_terms_required: You must accept the Terms / Disclaimer before creating an account.
acquisitions_desc: Buys and other lot-building transactions in the selected period. These values increase cost basis but do not realize gains without a disposal.
address_book_desc: Store labels for wallets, counterparties or exchange addresses locally inside the encrypted vault.
assets_prices_desc: Manage asset types, aliases and manual historical prices.
auth_eyebrow: Private portfolio · Local encryption · Cloud Connect
auth_profile_hint: Your passphrase and data stay on your device. Cloud Connect is optional and encrypted.
auth_subtitle: Manage transactions, holdings, holding periods and reports directly in your browser.
auth_unauthorized_delete: Access protection is missing or wrong. Cloud Connect was not deleted.
balance_snapshots_desc: Stores historical portfolio states for charts, review and year comparisons.
choose_account: Choose your account and unlock it with your passphrase.
choose_profile: Choose your account and unlock it with your passphrase.
cloud_account_managed: Automatically derived from your recovery phrase. There is no separate identifier for you to remember or store.
cloud_add_failed: Cloud server could not be added
cloud_delete_recovery_required: To delete from one or more cloud servers, enter this account’s 24 recovery words.
cloud_delete_requires_recovery: Deleting Cloud Connect data requires this account’s 24-word recovery phrase.
cloud_desc: Connect Traeky to one or more cloud services. Backups stay end-to-end encrypted and can be restored with your recovery phrase.
cloud_edit_url_prompt: Enter the new cloud server URL:
cloud_explain: Cloud assignment and access protection are separately derived from your recovery phrase. The server never receives your recovery phrase or vault key and cannot decrypt your data.
cloud_newer_copy: At least one cloud server has a newer version. Restore it first or explicitly overwrite the remote version.
cloud_retention_days: Inactive Cloud Connect data is deleted after {days} days.
cloud_retention_explain: The cloud service reports this retention period. Every successful upload refreshes the activity timestamp.
cloud_server_added: Cloud server added and automatic sync enabled.
cloud_server_duplicate: This cloud server is already configured.
cloud_server_removed: Cloud server removed from this account.
cloud_server_removed_remote: Cloud server removed and Cloud Connect data deleted on this server.
cloud_server_update_failed: Cloud server could not be updated
cloud_server_updated: Cloud server updated and automatic sync started.
cloud_terms_accept: I have read and accept these cloud server terms/disclaimer.
cloud_terms_intro: The server provides the following terms/disclaimer for
cloud_terms_missing: This server did not provide a custom disclaimer. By continuing, you confirm that you use this cloud server at your own risk.
cloud_terms_required: You must accept the cloud server terms/disclaimer before adding this server.
cloud_urls_hint: Enter a cloud server URL. Traeky automatically syncs to every enabled server.
coingecko_consent_label: I agree that Traeky may request price data directly from CoinGecko.
coingecko_consent_desc: The requested CoinGecko IDs and your IP address are sent to CoinGecko. Without consent, automatic and manual CoinGecko price updates remain disabled; manual prices still work.
confirm_pull: Load Cloud Connect data and replace the current local version if decryption succeeds?
csv_import_desc: Import Traeky CSV files from old or current exports.
delete_cloud_confirm_copy: This deletes the complete Cloud Connect data on all configured cloud servers. Enter YES, your login passphrase and this account’s 24-word recovery phrase.
delete_cloud_desc: Deletes the complete Cloud Connect data for this account on the connected cloud service. Local data stays intact.
delete_cloud_server_copy: Removes this cloud server from your account. Optionally, Traeky can also delete the encrypted Cloud Connect data on this server only.
delete_cloud_server_remote: Also delete encrypted data on this cloud server
delete_cloud_server_remote_hint: Deleting data on the server requires YES, your login passphrase and this account’s 24-word recovery phrase. Without this option, only the local server link is removed.
delete_local_confirm: Really delete the current local account? Cloud Connect data remains untouched.
delete_local_confirm_copy: This removes the current account completely from this device. Cloud Connect data remains untouched. Enter YES and your login passphrase.
existing_data_desc: Found Traeky browser data is offered for import on startup. CSV files can be imported here anytime.
export_note: CSV exports contain transaction data only. Passphrase and cloud access protection are never exported.
export_report_desc: Export your transactions or download a PDF report.
file_import_copy: Choose a previously exported, encrypted Traeky file and enter your passphrase. When opened via Chrome/Edge, Traeky can automatically save future changes back to it.
file_not_connected: No file connected. Connect a file to automatically save every change to it, encrypted — as an alternative to Cloud Connect.
file_permission_needed: Access to the connected file needs to be re-granted. Click “Save now”.
file_storage_desc: Automatically save your encrypted vault to a local file — an offline backup alongside or instead of Cloud Connect.
file_sync_unsupported: Your browser does not support saving to a file automatically (Chrome/Edge only). Use the encrypted export/import via the “Open from file” tab instead.
holding_period_desc: Positions expiring inside your configured window.
income_rewards_desc: Staking rewards, rewards, airdrops, interest and cashback with fiat value at receipt time.
legacy_found: Traeky found existing browser data. Unlock it with the previous passphrase. Traeky will then show a new 24-word recovery phrase and move the data into a new protected account.
legacy_import_reason: Existing data imported into recovery account
legacy_none: No previous browser data was found on this device. CSV files can be imported after signing in.
legacy_ready_for_recovery: Data unlocked. Save the new recovery phrase to complete the migration.
local_snapshots_desc: Traeky stores encrypted restore points locally in this browser after changes. They are used for undo and are not synced to the cloud.
local_storage_full: Your browser's local storage is full. The change could not be saved. Please delete unused accounts or data, or sync/export your data to free up space.
migrate_found: Import found local Traeky data now
missing_price_import_warning: Line {line}: no price for {asset}; the import will still be applied. You can add a historical price later for PnL/tax reports.
missing_price_warning: Missing price for {asset} on event #{id}. Add a historical price or event price for a more accurate tax/PnL calculation.
missing_fee_price_warning: Missing price for fee asset {asset} on event #{id}. Fee value cannot be converted to {currency} and is excluded from cost basis.
name: Name
no_account_device: No account on this device yet.
no_expiring: No expiring holding periods in the configured window.
no_income_events: No income/reward events in this period.
no_profile_device: No account on this device yet.
no_tax_events: No taxable disposals in this period.
occupied_key: This cloud assignment is already occupied. Restore the existing Cloud Connect data with your recovery phrase.
passphrase_change_same: The new passphrase must be different from the current one.
price_auto_refresh_hint: Automatic price update every 5 minutes on the dashboard
profile_delete_has_transactions: This profile still has assigned transactions. Reassign or delete them first.
profile_manager_note: Switching accounts locks the current account. Each account has its own settings and Cloud Connect data.
profiles_desc: Create profiles inside this account and assign transactions to them. The account keeps one seedphrase and one Cloud Connect setup.
profiles_manager_note: A profile can only be deleted when it has no assigned transactions. Edit transactions or export first if you want to split data differently.
recovery_cancel_warning: If you cancel, this recovery phrase is discarded and a new one is generated next time.
recovery_confirm_copy: Confirm the requested words before the account is created.
recovery_confirm_failed: The confirmed words do not match the recovery phrase.
recovery_dialog_intro: Your account is almost ready. First save your recovery phrase. Then the words are hidden and you confirm randomly requested words.
recovery_enabled_desc: This account can be restored with the recovery phrase shown during setup. The words are not stored locally and cannot be displayed again.
recovery_phrase_copy: Write these 24 words down in the correct order. Traeky shows them only once and cannot recover them later.
recovery_phrase_unavailable: Recovery phrase could not be generated.
recovery_restore_copy: Enter your 24 recovery words and one or more Cloud Connect server URLs to load the newest encrypted backup.
recovery_understood: I have stored the recovery phrase safely
recovery_words_hidden: The recovery phrase is no longer visible. Enter the requested words from your saved copy.
remote_conflict: Remote conflict: restore the backup first or reset the revision.
restore_cloud_check_ok: Cloud servers checked: {ok}/{total} reachable and terms accepted.
restore_cloud_required: Enter at least one Cloud Connect server URL.
restore_cloud_urls_hint: Required for Cloud Restore: enter one or more Cloud Connect server URLs. Each server is checked and its terms/disclaimer must be accepted before restore.
restore_empty_created: Account created from recovery phrase. No Cloud Connect data was loaded.
search_placeholder: Search asset, source, note, tx id
seed_derived_cloud: The 24-word recovery phrase is all users need. Traeky manages the cloud assignment internally.
settings_portfolio_desc: These settings apply to the currently opened account.
setup_copy: Create a new account for this device. You can add multiple profiles inside the account later.
snapshot_restore_confirm: Restore this snapshot? The current state will be saved as a new snapshot and synced automatically afterwards.
snapshots_pruned: Up to {count} snapshots are stored in the account.
sync_all: Back up to all servers now
sync_desc: Upload an encrypted backup or restore the latest cloud version.
tax_report_desc: Calculate realized gains, cost basis and warnings locally from your events.
taxable_disposals_desc: Realized PnL is created only by sells and other disposals.
timeline_desc: Profile-scoped estimated portfolio value by transaction date.
tx_book_desc: Filter, edit, delete and calculate locally.
tx_saved_note: After saving, your account is encrypted automatically.
vault_desc: Change the passphrase, export an encrypted backup or remove this account from the device.
cloud_version_mismatch: Dashboard version {dashboard} is not compatible with cloud version {cloud}. Update Dashboard and Cloud to the same release.
cloud_commit_mismatch: Dashboard commit is not compatible with this cloud server. Update Dashboard and Cloud to the same build or disable strict commit matching on the cloud server.
cloud_terms_reaccept_required: Cloud server terms/disclaimer changed. Test the cloud server and accept the current terms again.
